text: In August 2026 LIV Golf announced an agreement with an unnamed lead investor that will 'carry and fund' the league from 2027, with players set to become majority equity holders ('LIV Golf 2.0') and seasons through 2030 affirmed; the investor's identity and terms were not disclosed.
short: LIV Golf's unnamed 2027 lead investor and planned player majority ownership (announced August 2026).

source.name: LIV Golf - LIV Golf reaches agreement with lead investor for its next era
